title: The Weir at Breitenau
_design: THE SEALS IN A ROW. Five named parties consent; their five tags and the Chancery's authenticating tag make six. Count first, then compare each impression with the Book of Matrices. Every die is live in 1221 and every impression answers. This is a clean CONFIRM and introduces no new Check. Portrait reuse is deliberate scaffold.
correct_reason_text: Five consenting parties and one authenticating Chancery seal are present. All six answer to live dies.

documents.claim_summary: Presents the common consent for rebuilding the weir: five named parties, authenticated by the Imperial Chancery.

documents.title: Common Consent for the Weir at Breitenau
documents.body_text:
The five parties named below consent to rebuild the weir at Breitenau. Each bears one fifth of the work and may draw one fifth of the water.

The Imperial Chancery authenticates their common act under its own seal.
documents.grantor: The five consenting parties named below
documents.property: The common weir, mill race, and five water shares
consenting_parties: The Cathedral Chapter of Saint Wend

lines.text: My masters send their common act. Five parties made one agreement; the Chancery put it into one packet.
There should be five for consent and one for the office.
All six were struck before the packet left the press.

outcomes.reaction: Good. The masons can open the race.
outcomes.register_note: Common consent for the Breitenau weir. Six live seals present. Confirmed.
outcomes.aftermath: The five parties rebuilt the weir under the admitted consent.
